tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Search stations in Germany and its neighbouring countries — river gauges, groundwater wells, reservoirs, coastal gauges — by name or water body, optionally filtered by region (a German federal state or a country code). latestValue is given in the station's unit.

tools.name: get_flood_situation
tools.description: Current flood situation: stations with an active LHP flood class (1 small … 4 very large), optionally per federal state.

tools.name: get_station
tools.description: Master data of one station: measurement type, current value with its unit, thresholds (MNW/MHW, alert marks, as stored valueCentimeters), flood class, coordinates.

tools.name: get_readings
tools.description: Time series for a station (downsampled to ≤200 points; history depth on this tier: last 90 days, default last 7 days). type "level" (default) → level series as stored valueCentimeters: centimetres above gauge zero for most gauges, but an elevation ×100 for groundwater wells and for gauges reporting

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Daily weather forecast at the station coordinate (DWD data via Bright Sky).

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Newest published water-level forecast for a station: the median of the state agency model run, future points within the horizon. Only gauges whose state publishes numeric forecasts have one, so an empty result is normal. Indicative, not an official warning.
